steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Fossil fuels (coal, oil, gas): reliable, high energy density, but produce CO2 and are non-renewable — being phased out for climate targets.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Nuclear power: low carbon, high output, reliable baseload — but radioactive waste, high decommissioning costs, public concern after Fukushima.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Solar PV: converts sunlight to electricity using photovoltaic cells — renewable, silent, low maintenance, but intermittent and needs storage.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Wind power: onshore and offshore turbines — renewable, scalable, but visual/noise impact, intermittent supply.
